== Book 2 ==

== Infobox ==

* Name: His Majesty

== Biography ==

"His Majesty" is the title used to address and refer to the Scarecrow in his capacity as ruler. The Soldier with the Green Whiskers uses the title when explaining what must be done with a newly arrived visitor, telling the Guardian of the Gates, "I must take him to His Majesty, the Scarecrow," and later cutting off further questions by stating, "That is His Majesty's business." Under this title the Scarecrow receives visitors directly: upon meeting Jack, His Majesty at first suspected the visitor of laughing at him, then made a careful examination and discovered that Jack's carved features were fixed in a permanent smile. His Majesty communicates partly through gestures, asking "Did you understand that sign?", and relies on Jellia to translate for a visitor, as when she reports, "His Majesty inquires if you are hungry." His Majesty is also shown occupied with leisure and practical matters of state, throwing quoits calmly even while his throne was said to be threatened, and later inspecting a horse brought to him, judging it critically with the remark, "He doesn't seem especially graceful!"

== Events ==

Under this title, the Scarecrow, ruler of the Emerald City, meets Jack Pumpkinhead.
